args.subject: Trail Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend the Cascade Falls Trail in the national park. It's perfect for weekend hikes, about 3 miles round trip, and offers beautiful waterfall views along the way.

Hope you get a chance to check it out!

Best regards

args.subject: Personal Trainer Recommendation: Alex
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Alex, a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. Alex is excellent at creating customized workout plans tailored to each person's goals and fitness level.

I think you'd really benefit from working with Alex. Let me know if you'd like any more details!

Best regards

args.subject: Piano Teacher Recommendation: Sarah
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I'd like to recommend Sarah, a fantastic piano teacher who specializes in classical music. She has been teaching for over 15 years and is an excellent choice for anyone looking to develop their piano skills.

Best regards

args.subject: App Recommendation: FitTrack
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend FitTrack, a new fitness app that's really helpful for tracking workouts. It also has great meal planning features, so it's a good all-in-one option for managing both your training and your nutrition.

Hope you give it a try!

Best regards

args.subject: Bakery Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I'd like to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown. Their sourdough bread is incredible, and they bake fresh every morning at 6 AM, so it's worth stopping by early.

Best regards
